sites.name: Silfra Diving

s1.quote: You can dive up to 18 meters max, diving deeper is prohibited. … cold water (2-4 on Celcius) … it is prohibited to enter caves or other overhead environments while diving.

s2.quote: Silfra descends to a maximum depth of 63 metres (207 ft).

access.value: National park rules: buddy required, dry suit certificate or 10 dry suit dives, no overhead entry

hazards.text: Very cold water; dry suit required

sites.depthNote: Park limit 18 m; fissure itself reaches 63 m (technical only)

summary.text: A water-filled fissure between the North American and Eurasian plates in Thingvellir National Park, known for extremely clear 2-4 C water. Dives are capped at 18 m, need a dry suit and a buddy, and stay out of caves.
